notes: Start corrected from 1800 to 1830 (French invasion). Was Regency of Algiers (Ottoman) before 1830. Cliopatria has Regency of Algiers polygons.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1885 (Bechuanaland Protectorate established). Independent Tswana kingdoms before 1885.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1882 (French Parliament ratified Brazza treaties). Loango and Teke kingdoms before 1882.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1885 (Congo Free State recognized at Berlin Conference). Luba Lunda and Kongo kingdoms before 1885. Paine et al. (2024) has pre-colonial state polygons.

Khedivate of Egypt including Sudan (conquered 1820-24) and Equatoria. Cliopatria polygon represents mid-century extent (~1.83M km2). Egypt lost Sudan to Mahdist revolt by 1885. Pre-1820: Egypt proper only (~1M km2).
Start corrected from 1800 to 1882 (Italy purchased Assab). Was Ethiopian Empire highlands and Ottoman coast before 1882.

Pre-Menelik Ethiopia. Zemene Mesafint (Era of Princes). Highland core only: Gondar, Gojjam, Shewa, Tigray, Wello. ~240,000 km2. Cliopatria polygon replaces back-projected CShapes which was 2-3x too large.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1839 (first French treaty with King Denis at Gabon Estuary). Mpongwe and Orungu coastal polities before 1839.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1821 (British Crown took over forts). Ashanti Empire dominated the region in 1800. Paine et al. (2024) has Ashanti polygon.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1861 (British annexation 6 Aug 1861). Yoruba kingdom of Lagos before 1861.

Merina Kingdom. Expanded from central highlands: 85K km2 (1796) -> 113K (1803) -> 173K (1820) -> 245K (1822) -> 375K (1825) -> 427K (1840-1894). Cliopatria polygon uses 1840 extent (~75% of island). Western Sakalava never fully subjugated. French colonization 1896. POLYGON CAVEAT: Polygon represents Merina Kingdom at 1840 peak extent (427K km2). Before 1840 the kingdom was 2-5x smaller (85K km2 in 1800). After 1894/96 the kingdom ceased to exist (French colonization). Polygon is a poor fit for both ends of the date range.

Alaouite Morocco. Cliopatria polygon (388K km2). Note: fixed borders remain conceptually anachronistic. Historical Morocco had Bled al-makhzen (governed territory) vs Bled es-siba (nominal allegiance only, Rif/Atlas). Southern border was non-existent.

Zanzibar Sultanate including mainland coastal strip (Cape Delgado to near Mogadishu, 1500km). Cliopatria polygon includes mainland (28K km2). Mainland lost 1886-1890 via Anglo-German treaties. Post-1890: islands only.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1884 (first British treaties with Somali clans). Somali clan societies and sultanates before 1884.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1884 (Nachtigal signed treaties 5 Jul 1884). Bamoun Kingdom Fulani lamidates and Duala polities before 1884.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1843 (British annexation 4 May 1843). Nguni peoples and Zulu Kingdom before 1843. Paine et al. (2024) has Zulu polygon.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1884 (protectorate proclaimed). Niger Delta city-states (Bonny Brass Calabar) before 1884.
Start corrected from 1800 to 1884 (Bonelli treaty 28 Nov 1884). Sahrawi tribal territories before 1884.

notes: Split from IRN-1800-2025. Qajar Iran including South Caucasus (modern Azerbaijan Armenia eastern Georgia). Lost to Russia via Treaty of Gulistan (1813) and Treaty of Turkmenchay (1828) ~170000+ km2. Cliopatria has Qajar boundaries. Cliopatria polygon: Qajar Dynasty 1800-1804. Qajar Iran including South Caucasus, pre-Treaty of Turkmenchay.
Split from IRN-1800-2025. Post-Turkmenchay borders. CShapes polygon (1622521 km2) approximately matches modern Iran.

Pre-1924 Arabian interior (Nejd, Hejaz, Asir) has no polygon source. CShapes starts Saudi at 1927. The Hejaz coast was Ottoman until 1916 (Arab Revolt), then Kingdom of Hejaz 1916-1925. Nejd (interior) was the Emirate of Nejd under Ibn Saud from 1902. No freely available GIS boundary data exists for these pre-unification entities.

Start year corrected: 1800 -> 1948 (Gaza Strip created after 1948 Arab-Israeli War)
Independent from Netherlands 1839. Personal union with Netherlands until 1890. FAOSTAT tracked as Belgium-Luxembourg until 1999.
Merged AUH-1800-1867 + AUH-1867-1908. The 1867 Ausgleich was constitutional, not territorial. CShapes polygon starts 1886; pre-1886 uses Cliopatria.
Merged AUH-1800-1867 + AUH-1867-1908. The 1867 Ausgleich was constitutional, not territorial. CShapes polygon starts 1886; pre-1886 uses Cliopatria.
Merged AUH-1800-1867 + AUH-1867-1908. The 1867 Ausgleich was constitutional, not territorial. CShapes polygon starts 1886; pre-1886 uses Cliopatria.
Start date corrected from 1800 to 1878 (Austro-Hungarian occupation after Congress of Berlin). Was Ottoman vilayet (Bosnia Vilayet) before 1878.
Split from DNK-1800-1920. Pre-1864 Denmark including Schleswig-Holstein (~57086 km2). CShapes-Europe has pre-1864 polygon. Resolves documented known limitation.
Split from DNK-1800-1920. Post-Second Schleswig War Denmark without Schleswig-Holstein (-33% territory ~38496 km2).

Start date corrected from 1800 to 1830 (Greek independence). Greece was Ottoman territory before 1830. Polygon back-projected from CShapes 1886 (63711 km2); Cliopatria has more accurate 1830-era boundaries (~47000 km2).
Start date corrected from 1800 to 1878 (Austro-Hungarian occupation after Congress of Berlin). Was Ottoman territory before 1878.

Split from SWE-1800-1905. Sweden including Finland (~800000 km2). Lost Finland to Russia in Treaty of Fredrikshamn 1809 (-42% territory). Cliopatria and histmaps R package have boundaries. Cliopatria polygon: Swedish Empire 1763-1808. Swedish Empire including Finland, pre-Treaty of Fredrikshamn.
Split from SWE-1800-1905. Sweden without Finland before gaining Norway. ~443000 km2. Cliopatria polygon: Swedish Empire 1809-1811. Sweden without Finland, before union with Norway.
Split from SWE-1800-1905. Personal union with Norway (Treaty of Kiel 1814). CShapes 2.0 polygon (761932 km2) valid for 1886-1905 portion.
Start year corrected: 1800 -> 1949 (East Berlin created with DDR 1949)

Island territory constant at ~109K km2 (no >10% area change). Political transitions: Spanish colony to 1898; US occupation 1899-1902; Republic (Platt Amendment) 1902; full sovereignty 1934; Cuban Revolution 1959. CShapes has 5 status periods. Not split because territory did not change.

notes: Pre-colonial kingdom in modern Ghana interior. ~154,508 km². Founded c.1670. Defeated by British 1896 (4th Anglo-Ashanti War). Cliopatria: 20 time-steps 1797-1894.

Largest state in 19th-century Africa. ~792,706 km². Founded by Usman dan Fodio's jihad 1804. Conquered by British 1903. Modern northern Nigeria/Niger/Cameroon. Cliopatria: 6 time-steps.. Includes Kano Emirate (caliphate's most commercially important vassal: trans-Saharan trade terminus, textile/indigo production center) and Katsina Emirate (leather, cloth). Both subsumed after Fulani jihad 1804-1808.
Pre-colonial kingdom in modern Benin. Founded c.1600. Conquered by France 1894 (Second Franco-Dahomean War). Not in Cliopatria by name.
Pre-colonial kingdom in modern KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. ~25,464 km². Founded by Shaka kaSenzangakhona. Defeated at Battle of Ulundi 1879 (Anglo-Zulu War). Cliopatria: 5 time-steps 1820-1894.
Pre-colonial empire in NE Nigeria/Chad/Niger. ~227,106 km². Successor to Kanem-Bornu (founded c.1380). Conquered by Rabih az-Zubayr 1893. Cliopatria: 8 time-steps 1636-1894.
Pre-colonial empire in eastern Chad. Founded c.1501. Conquered by France 1912. Cliopatria: 2 time-steps 1636-1894.
Pre-colonial sultanate in western Sudan. Founded c.1603. Conquered by Khedivate of Egypt 1874. Briefly re-independent 1898-1916 under Ali Dinar. Cliopatria: 3 time-steps 1636-1876.
Pre-colonial kingdom in central Uganda. Founded c.1300. British protectorate established 1894. Core of modern Uganda (name derived from Buganda).
Pre-colonial kingdom in western Uganda. Founded c.1300. Once the dominant power in the Great Lakes region. Conquered by British 1899.
Pre-colonial kingdom in modern Edo State, Nigeria (NOT modern Republic of Benin). Founded c.1180. Famous for Benin Bronzes. Conquered by British 1897 (Punitive Expedition).
Pre-colonial empire in Katanga region, modern DRC. Founded c.1585. Absorbed into Congo Free State 1885.
Pre-colonial empire spanning modern DRC, Angola, and Zambia. Founded c.1665. Split between Belgian, Portuguese, and British colonial territories by 1887.
Pre-colonial Fula theocratic state in Guinea highlands. Founded 1727. Conquered by France 1896. One of the first jihad states in West Africa.
Pre-colonial kingdom in Matabeleland, modern Zimbabwe. Founded by Mzilikazi after fleeing Shaka's Zulu Kingdom. Conquered by Cecil Rhodes' BSAC 1893-94 (First Matabele War).
Pre-colonial Nguni kingdom in southern Mozambique. Founded by Soshangane after the Mfecane. Conquered by Portugal 1895. Last king Ngungunhane exiled to Azores.
Pre-colonial Yoruba empire in southwestern Nigeria. At peak controlled much of Yorubaland and Dahomey. Collapsed by 1836 from Fulani jihad and internal revolt. Capital Old Oyo abandoned.
Pre-colonial kingdom. Existed from c.15th century. Came under German East Africa sphere c.1890. Continued as monarchy under colonial rule until 1961.
Pre-colonial kingdom. Existed from c.17th century. Came under German East Africa sphere c.1890. Continued as monarchy under colonial rule. Paired with Rwanda as Ruanda-Urundi mandate.

Pre-colonial kingdom founded by Moshoeshoe I. Unified Sotho peoples against Zulu/Ndebele pressure. Became British protectorate Basutoland 1868 at Moshoeshoe's request to avoid Boer expansion. Modern Lesotho.
Pre-colonial kingdom in modern Eswatini. Founded c.1750. Came under joint Boer-British administration 1894. Modern Eswatini preserves the monarchy.
Pre-colonial kingdom in western Zambia (Barotseland). Founded c.17th century. Became British protectorate under BSAC 1890 (Lochner Concession).
Confederation of states (Bussa, Nikki, Illo, Kaiama) on Nigeria-Benin border. Partitioned between British and French 1897-98.
Pre-colonial kingdom in northern Ghana. Founded c.1400s. German protectorate 1899, then British after WWI.
Mossi states (Ouagadougou, Yatenga, Tenkodogo) in modern Burkina Faso. Founded c.15th century. Conquered by France 1896-97.
Sultanate centered on Zinder, modern Niger. Founded c.1736. Conquered by France 1899 (Battle of Tirmini).
Hausa state in northern Nigeria. One of the original Hausa Bakwai. Conquered by Sokoto Caliphate 1808 during Usman dan Fodio's jihad. Continued resistance from exile at Tsibiri.
Gbe kingdom on the coast of modern Benin (capital of modern Benin). Founded c.16th century. French protectorate from 1863, formally 1882.
Fula Islamic state on Senegal-Mali border (Faleme River valley). Founded c.1690s. Conquered by France ~1887.
Fula Islamic state along middle Senegal River (northern Senegal). Founded 1776. French conquest began 1855, effective control 1859-62.
Pre-colonial kingdom at Niger-Benue confluence (Kogi State, Nigeria). Founded c.16th century. Came under British Royal Niger Company 1901.
Wolof kingdom at the mouth of the Senegal River (Saint-Louis area). One of the oldest Wolof states. Conquered by France 1855 (Governor Faidherbe).
Wolof kingdom in western Senegal (between Dakar and Saint-Louis). Founded c.1549. Last Damel Lat Dior killed 1886 resisting French railway construction.
Serer kingdom in Sine-Saloum region, Senegal. Founded c.14th century. French protectorate 1887.
Wolof kingdom in interior Senegal. Rump of the former Jolof Empire (fragmented c.1550). Conquered by France ~1890.
Serer kingdom in Sine-Saloum region, Senegal (paired with Sine). Founded c.14th century. French protectorate 1887.
Pre-colonial kingdom in southwestern Uganda. Founded c.15th century. Incorporated into Uganda Protectorate 1901.
Imbangala kingdom in the Kwango valley, Angola. Founded c.1620. Major slave trade hub. Effectively subjugated by Portuguese by early 1900s, fully absorbed ~1911.
Autonomous Ottoman beylik in modern Tunisia. Husainid dynasty from 1705. French protectorate (Treaty of Bardo) 1881.
Pre-colonial kingdom in northern Zambia (Chitimukulu paramount). Founded c.17th century. BSAC control 1899.
Yoruba military republic and successor to Oyo Empire hegemony. Founded ~1829 by warriors fleeing Fulani advance. Dominant Yoruba power by 1840s. British treaty 1893.
Yoruba state centered on Abeokuta. Founded ~1830 by Egba refugees from the Oyo collapse. Had formal self-government; recognized as independent by Britain until 1914.
Yoruba kingdom in southwestern Nigeria. Major trade power controlling access to Lagos lagoon. Conquered by Britain 1892 (Ijebu Expedition).
Eastern Lunda kingdom in Luapula valley (Zambia/DRC border). Offshoot of Lunda Empire (Mwata Kazembe). Major copper and salt trade. BSAC control ~1899.

Pre-imperial Japan. Home islands only (~370,776 km2). Treaty of Shimonoseki (1895) marks beginning of colonial expansion.

notes: Empire period. +Taiwan (Treaty of Shimonoseki 1895), +S. Sakhalin (Treaty of Portsmouth 1905), +Korea (annexed 1910). ~658,000 km2 at peak. Manchukuo (1932-45) tracked separately as MAN-1932-1945.
US occupation (SCAP). All colonies stripped. Treaty of San Francisco (1952-04-28) restores sovereignty.
Post-occupation. Okinawa reverted 1972. Kuril Islands dispute with Russia unresolved.

Composite: Bonny, Opobo (1870-1887), New Calabar (Kalabari), Brass (Nembe), Old Calabar (Efik). World's largest palm oil exporters. Predecessor to Oil Rivers Protectorate. Territory: Niger Delta mangrove coast, Cross River estuary.

Middle Niger River trade hub. Famous for brass and glass bead manufacture, cloth production. Nominally under Sokoto/Gwandu but operationally autonomous. Conquered by Royal Niger Company Jan 1897 (Bida fell Jan 29). Capital: Bida (6.01E, 9.08N).

Pre-Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo. Included Central America until 1823 (~4.4M km2), then ~3.2M km2. Lost Texas de facto 1836. Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo (1848-02-02) ceded California, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, New Mexico to US (~55% loss).
Post-Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo. Gadsden Purchase (1854, -77K km2) is sub-threshold (-3.9%). Territory stable at ~1.96M km2 since 1854.
United Kingdom of Netherlands (1815-1830) including Belgium and Luxembourg. ~71K km2. Belgian Revolution 1830 led to -42% territory loss.
Netherlands after Belgian secession. ~41K km2. Luxembourg personal union until 1890.
Greater Nepal under Prithvi Narayan Shah's successors. ~227K km2 at peak (1814). Treaty of Sugauli (1816) ceded Sikkim, Kumaon, Garhwal, western Terai to British India. -34% territory loss.
Nepal post-Sugauli Treaty. ~149K km2. Borders largely stable since 1816.

Omani Empire including East African coast (Zanzibar, Pemba, mainland strip). Said bin Sultan ruled from Zanzibar (moved capital 1840). ~176K km2 at peak. Split on his death 1856: Zanzibar and Oman became separate sultanates.
Sultanate of Oman (Muscat) after separation from Zanzibar 1856. ~80-310K km2 (varying with interior tribal control). Zanzibar tracked separately as ZAN-1856-1964.
Includes Gran Colombia period (1819-1830): Colombia + Venezuela + Ecuador + Panama. ~4.3M km2 at peak. Dissolved 1830: Venezuela and Ecuador seceded. -34% loss.
Republic of New Granada / Colombia after Gran Colombia. ~2.8M km2. Lost Panama 1903.
Original 13 states + early territories (Ohio, Kentucky, Tennessee, Vermont). ~1.2M km2. Louisiana Purchase (1803) doubles territory.
Post-Louisiana Purchase (1803, +2.1M km2). Florida (Adams-Onis 1819). Texas annexation (1845). Oregon Treaty (1846). ~3.5M km2 by 1845. Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo (1848) triggers next split.
Post-Mexican Cession (Guadalupe Hidalgo 1848, +1.4M km2). Gadsden Purchase (1854). Civil War (1861-1865). ~4.3M km2 pre-Alaska. Alaska Purchase (1867) triggers next split.
Alaska Purchase (1867, +1.7M km2). Territory stable at ~9.4M km2. Hawaii Territory (1898). Admitted as 49th and 50th states 1959.
Russian Empire pre-Crimean War. ~17.4M km2. Acquisitions: Georgia (1801), Finland (1809), Bessarabia (1812), Congress Poland (1815). Caucasus conquest ongoing. Crimean War (1853-56) ends this period.

Russian Empire post-Crimean War. Massive Central Asian expansion: Tashkent (1865), Bukhara protectorate (1868), Khiva (1873), Kokand (1876), Merv (1884). Far East: Amur/Ussuri (1858-60), Sakhalin (1875). ~22M km2 by 1900. Russo-Japanese War (1904-05) triggers next period.
Konbaung Dynasty at peak. ~798K km2 including Arakan, Manipur, Assam. First Anglo-Burmese War (1824-26) ends with Treaty of Yandabo: lost Arakan, Tenasserim, Assam, Manipur. -31% territory.
Post-First Anglo-Burmese War. ~553K km2. Second Anglo-Burmese War (1852): Britain seizes Lower Burma (Pegu). -21% territory.
Upper Burma only. ~437K km2. Third Anglo-Burmese War (1885): Britain conquers Upper Burma. Kingdom abolished 1 Jan 1886.
British Burma 1886-1948. Independence 1948. Military rule 1962-2011. Name changed to Myanmar 1989.

Ottoman Empire at near-maximum extent. Lost Greece (1832), parts of Caucasus to Russia, Algeria to France (1830). Cliopatria polygon represents 1800 extent (~2.66M km2). Actual territory contracted significantly during this period.
Ottoman Empire post-1878 losses (Romania, Serbia, Montenegro, Bulgaria autonomous). Still holds Bosnia (occupied by Austria-Hungary), Libya, Hejaz, Mesopotamia, Levant.

Ottoman Empire after Bosnia formally annexed by Austria-Hungary (1908). Lost Libya to Italy (1911-12). Balkan Wars (1912-13) cost most remaining European territory. Collapse led to modern Turkey and Arab states.
